lines: +git config user.email a@test; git config user.name A
+echo base > f; mkdir sub; echo x > sub/g; git add .; git commit -qm base
+git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) obj=%(objectname) type=%(objecttype) peeled=%(*objectname) peeledtype=%(*objecttype) symref=%(symref)'
+git rev-list --objects HEAD atag outertag blobtag treetag subtreetag
+# index only blob in subdir (cache tree?)
+# Now cache-tree in index points to subtree trees for staged content; remove staged file from index but update worktree? Keep.
+# add a future commit and a stash
+echo future > fut; git add fut; git commit -qm future; future=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+echo stashchange > f; git stash push -q -m s1 -- f
+echo "after repack+prune (refs still include stash, future commit is reflog-only due reset)"
+git stash list; git stash show --stat 2>&1 | head
+echo "== expire reflogs except stash manually not; test stash reflog repack"
+echo change2 > sub/g; git stash push -q -m s2 -- sub/g
+printf 'option no-deref\ndelete refs/heads/alias %s\n' "$(git rev-parse refs/heads/alias)" | git update-ref --stdin; echo "update-ref no-deref rc:$?"
+git rev-parse refs/heads/main; git rev-parse refs/heads/alias 2>&1 || echo alias gone
